source.title: 9 août 1830 — La Charte constitutionnelle révisée — Assemblée nationale
source.citation_text: The French National Assembly documents the deputies' revision of the 1814 Charter, Louis-Philippe's acceptance and oath on 9 August 1830 as roi des Français, and the charter's promulgation on 14 August. This distinguishes his personal institutional oath from 2 August Charles X abdication and the Parliament's broader 2 August governmental-period table.

source.title: Février 1848 — Révolution de février — Assemblée nationale
source.citation_text: The National Assembly documents the royal abdication of Louis-Philippe on 24 February 1848, failure of the proposed regency, creation of a provisional government, and separate 25 February formal Republic proclamation in this official chronology. The 24 February day is used as the July Monarchy constitutional-authority exit, without claiming minute-specific succession.

period.notes: The July Monarchy's constitutional government regime in France: start is Louis-Philippe's 9 August 1830 oath to the revised 1814 Charter as King of the French per the French National Assembly; end is his abdication and the collapse of monarchical government on 24 February 1848. This axis is constitutionally institutional, NOT an exact-day ownership of every Act of State or an uninterrupted reign including the July 1830 revolution. The National Assembly overall government-regime table uses an alternate 2 August 1830 start (Charles X abdication), while the revised Charter was formally promulgated 14 August; those are different event conventions, not claims that the sources disagree about the oath itself. The late Restoration royal state_form designation on the same France UUID has valid_to_granularity='year' and ends in the year 1830, yielding an apparent intra-1830 date overlap; P2-01I does NOT mutate that already-source-linked original designation or assert that the Bourbon Restoration lasted alongside Louis-Philippe's reign. A separate exact source-aware designation-boundary review is required; do not infer an exclusive 1830 state-form assignment, particularly for Lafayette's coarse 1827-1830 Activity. The normalized governance record is on historical country-umbrella France only, not the legally continuous post-1870 French Republic or any separate sovereign July Monarchy Polity. Every existing 65 Person Activities, role, dates and normalized sources are preserved; no July Monarchy ruler Person is fabricated.
